name: calendar-create-event
description: Create a new calendar event. Attendees receive invitation emails automatically. A standing meeting is ONE event with recurrence, never a copy per week.

inputs.title: string
inputs.attendees: object[]? (each { email, name? }. Cannot set RSVP status; use calendar-respond-to-invite for the principal's own RSVP.)
inputs.conferencing: object? (new link: { provider: Google Meet/Microsoft Teams, autocreate: true }. Zoom/other existing link: { provider, details: { url } })
inputs.recurrence: string[]? (one RRULE plus optional EXDATE lines, e.g. ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO"]; start is the first occurrence)

outputs.warnings: string[]? (present when an overlapping hold with attendees was left in place)
